key_insight: AI/ML is becoming a core chemical engineering tool, especially when combined with first-principles and physics-informed models.
engineering_relevance: These methods improve prediction, discovery, and decision-making across scales from atoms to industrial processes while preserving thermodynamic and conservation-law consistency.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes representative applications across atomic-scale simulation, materials discovery, transport, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations rather than reporting a single benchmark study.
watch_item: Performance can degrade under data scarcity or extrapolation, so model interpretability, consistency, and lifecycle management remain critical.
paper_title: Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering
